Scheme S10 Preparation of ISM061-18 and ISM061-18-2
Step 1: Preparation of Compound 18-1
To a solution of 2-chloro-5-iodopyrimidine (1.5 g, 6.24 mmol) in 1,4-dioxane (15 mL) was added
C2H3BF3K (1.3 g, 9.36 mmol), CsF (1.9 g, 12.48 mmol) and Pd(dppf)Cl2 (0.9 g, 1.25 mmol) at 25 ℃
under N2 atmosphere. After addition, the reaction mixture was heated and stirred at 80 ℃ under a
nitrogen atmosphere for 12 h. After cooling to 25 ℃, the reaction mixture was poured into ice water
(150 mL) and extracted with EtOAc (70 mL × 3), the combined organic layers were washed with
brine (100 mL), dried over Na2SO4, filtered and concentrated under reduced pressure to give a residue,
which was purified by column chromatography on silica gel eluting with ethyl acetate (from 0% to
6.4%) in petroleum ether to give the title compound (560 mg, 63.8% yield) as a yellow liquid. LCMS
Step 2: Preparation of Compound 18-2 and Compound 18-3
To a solution of 2-chloro-5-vinylpyrimidine (540 mg, 3.84 mmol) in 1,4-dioxane-H2O (6 mL, 5:1)
was added K2CO3 (1592 mg, 11.52 mmol), (2-fluoro-6-hydroxyphenyl)boronic acid (1198 mg, 7.68
mmol) and Pd(dppf)Cl2 (562 mg, 0.77 mmol) at 25 ℃ under N2 atmosphere. After addition, the
reaction mixture was heated and stirred at 80 ℃ under a nitrogen atmosphere for 12 h. After cooling
